sections.heading: Earlier Setback Norms (OUTDATED)
sections.content: Para 1: Setback of 5m from water body edge sufficient for projects <5,000 sq.m. [NOTE: OUTDATED - Superseded by GO(P) No. 45/2024/LSGD].

sections.heading: Earlier Environmental Clearance Exemption (OUTDATED)
sections.content: Para 2: Environmental clearance not mandatory for commercial projects <5,000 sq.m. [NOTE: OUTDATED - Superseded by GO(P) No. 45/2024/LSGD].
